title: Affine base change for the right adjoint of a proper flat morphism
statement: Let Y and Y' be affine schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let g:Y'\to Y be a morphism, and let f:X\to Y be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], and of finite presentation. Form X'=X\times_Y Y' with g_X:X'\to X and f':X'\to Y' [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let a and a' be right adjoints to Rf_* and Rf'_* on quasi-coherent derived categories [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Then for every K in D_QCoh(Y), the canonical base-change morphism Lg_X^*a(K)\to a'(Lg^*K) is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Supply derived localizations on opens from the ambient derived category.
The morphism g is affine because both bases are affine. Its base change is affine; properness supplies compactness and quasi-separatedness of X prime.

Apply the affine pullback perfect detection theorem to the canonical mate map; its Hom-bijectivity hypothesis is supplied by the proper-flat Hom comparison. All shifts and all perfect complexes are tested.
